name: Status Monitoring with Full Calendar Integration

parameters.prompt:
=Analyze this job-search related email and classify it:

From: {{ $json.from }}
Subject: {{ $json.subject }}
Body: {{ $json.body }}

Classify this email into one of these categories:
1. INTERVIEW_REQUEST - Someone wants to schedule an interview
2. REJECTION - Application was declined  
3. ACKNOWLEDGMENT - Application was received
4. INFO_REQUEST - They need additional information
5. OFFER - Job offer or next round invitation
6. OTHER - Something else job-related

If it's an INTERVIEW_REQUEST, also extract:
- Company name
- Position title
- Contact person name
- Any time constraints mentioned
- Urgency level (low/medium/high)

Return ONLY a JSON object with this structure:
{
  "category": "INTERVIEW_REQUEST",
  "confidence": 95,
  "company": "Company Name",
  "position": "Job Title", 
  "contact_person": "Name",
  "time_constraints": "any mentioned constraints",
  "urgency": "medium",
  "reasoning": "why you classified it this way"
}

parameters.subject: =Re: {{ $json.originalEmail.subject }}
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json.contact_person || 'there' }},

Thank you for your interest in my application for the {{ $json.position || 'position' }} at {{ $json.company || 'your company' }}!

I'm very excited about this opportunity and would love to schedule the interview. Based on my current availability, I can offer the following times:

**Option 1:** {{ $json.availableSlots[0]?.formatted || 'Tomorrow 10:00 AM' }}
**Option 2:** {{ $json.availableSlots[1]?.formatted || 'Day after tomorrow 2:00 PM' }}
**Option 3:** {{ $json.availableSlots[2]?.formatted || 'Next week 4:00 PM' }}

Please let me know which option works best for your team, and I'll send a calendar invitation right away.

I'm looking forward to discussing how my experience in AI adoption and legal technology can contribute to {{ $json.company || 'your company' }}'s goals.

Best regards,
Eric Kazee
Phone: (your-phone-number)
Email: ekazee@outlook.com

---
Ref: {{ $json.slotSelectionToken }}

columnValues.notes: Auto-generated 3 time slot options based on calendar availability
